sourceText: Operator request (2026-07-03, translated from Chinese chat): Do not use dual-host parallel implementation; develop under the standard Lattice CLI workflow. Start with S1 (of the milestone slicing proposed from the merged rev-2 ablation execution plan: S1 = M0 protocol freeze + M2 pair ledger + M5 sample-size calculator, the experiment-side pure-tooling cluster).
normalizedOutcome: Three runnable experiment tools with passing hermetic selfchecks exist under experiments/experience-ablation/ on main after a full Lattice lifecycle: protocol.mjs (freeze/validate a machine-checked protocol.json with canonical sha256 protocolHash + frozen memorySnapshotHash), pair-ledger.mjs (deterministic seeded run order; refuses without a frozen protocol; immutable once a score record exists), sample-size.mjs (per-population adequacy report reproducing the plan-reviewed S7 anchors and the executable Wilson-CI pilot freeze rule).
acceptanceClaim: node experiments/experience-ablation/protocol-selfcheck.mjs && node experiments/experience-ablation/pair-ledger-selfcheck.mjs && node experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size-selfcheck.mjs all exit 0 on the story branch, with the sample-size selfcheck asserting the four plan-reviewed anchor values (294/62/27/58) and the pair-ledger selfcheck proving the frozen-protocol refusal and post-score immutability.
